title: Docker Zero UI redesign board, V2 popup (popup and corner box)
lede: Proposed redesign (direction B: centred ring with the logo's orca, brand colours, long-step feedback), rendered from the app frontend with the same mocked services as the current-UI board. The Settings window moved to V2-setting and the Setup window to V2-setup. Every state keeps the id of its current-UI twin; the motion frames and the long-step setup states are extra. Mark each Keep, Revise or Discuss.
regenerate: uvx --from playwright --with pillow python -I <frontdoor-ui-gallery>/scripts/shoot.py render design/ui-gallery/V2-popup/gallery.json

popup.title: Tray popup
popup.opens: Click the tray icon, or launch the exe while it already runs.

corner.title: Corner box
corner.opens: Corner box switch in the popup, or Show corner box in the tray menu; stays on top at the bottom right.

states.title: Loading
states.how: The first moment after the popup opens, before a status arrives.

states.title: Running
states.how: Distro, Docker and Portainer up; keepalive hold on.

states.title: Starting
states.how: Right after Start, until Portainer answers (up to 90 s).

states.title: Stopping

states.title: Not installed
